corrections: Initial sandbox runs could not write the default engine log or read the Windows certificate store. Test APPDATA was isolated inside build; final engine checks used approved Windows certificate access.

Initial structural run reproduced two test-library save failures from using a res://../ path with Windows absolute directory APIs. Globalized workspace paths corrected the fixture; all four initial physical drives/replays already passed.
First visual review enlarged sparse small pines and replaced two rectangular snow-covered cliff pieces with natural boulders. Final content retains the same racing geometry.
The sector review camera initially used authoring +Y instead of world -Z. Only the review fixture pose changed.

A --prepare native run compared unencoded generated floating-point values with JSON-read values and reproduced two exact draft-equality failures. Normalizing generated documents through the actual JSON format corrected the fixture; content save/reload assertions remain exact.

Local account destination preflight first rejected a backslash-dependent vault context. Normalizing the explicit user-root to the original forward-slash context resolved the read-only lookup. No authentication or network request was made.
provenance: Original authored layouts and prop composition using existing project-owned Winter assets. No external/generated media or new runtime dependency.
remaining_acceptance: Physical-device rendering, input, frame pacing and memory
